Plot CPUE time series by gear group

Source: R/hr_techreport_plot_cpue.R
hr_techreport_plot_cpue.Rd

Queries the logbook table, groups gears according to gear_group, calculates catch per unit effort for each gear, and produces a faceted CPUE time series plot.

Usage

hr_techreport_plot_cpue(
  pcon,
  gear_group = list(GIL = "GIL", BMT = c("BMT", "NPT", "SHT", "PGT", "DRD"), LLN =
    c("HLN", "LLN"), DSE = c("PSE", "DSE")),
  year_start = 1000,
  year_end = 9999,
  limit = 0.5,
  effort_na = 1,
  drop_no_effort = TRUE,
  hooks_na = 10000
)

Arguments

pcon

A database connection object compatible with dplyr::tbl.

gear_group

Named list mapping gear group labels to vectors of MFDB gear codes. Default groups are GIL, BMT, LLN, and DSE.

year_start

Integer. First year to include. Default is 1000.

year_end

Integer. Last year to include. Default is 9999.

limit

Share of the species in the catch above which records count as directed (the dashed lines), passed to pax::pax_logbook_cpue_plot(). Default 0.5.

effort_na

Effort of records with no tow time, hooks or nets (a bottom trawl haul without tow time), passed to pax::pax_add_cpue(). Default 1 (one hour); NULL leaves them out.

drop_no_effort

If TRUE (default), records with none of hooks, nets or tow time are left out before effort_na applies (Danish seine records count as one set).

hooks_na

Number of hooks given to records without, of any gear. Default 10000, as before: a bottom trawl haul without tow time then has an effort of 10. NULL leaves them without hooks, so effort_na applies.

Value

A ggplot2 plot object faceted by gear group.
